title: Public Alert No. 07/2025 – Alert on Falsified OXYCONTIN 80mg identified in the WHO European Region
summary: NAFDAC alerts on falsified OxyContin 80mg (batch 262174, exp 12/2025) found in Switzerland, imitating Mundipharma's Polish product. Tablets contained no oxycodone but a nitazene synthetic opioid, risking overdose and death. Surveillance ordered in Nigeria.
